/nodes/speak/extraction_schema/0/descrip.source: Extract ONLY the latest reply as plain delimiter text, NEVER JSON. One row per distinct product decision. Every row has exactly ten fields separated by | in this order: kind|products|amount|date|complete|scope|security_answer|callback_time|ai|scam. End with a separate literal END line. Empty facts use empty fields. complete, ai, scam are exactly 0 or 1. scope is current/all/total/each. Products are comma-separated exact returned IDs, known API enums, spaced names (credit card, personal loan, car loan), or exact rendered labels. Escape literal percent as %25, vertical bar as %7C, newline as %0A and comma within a product as %2C. Do not add quotes, brackets, markdown or spaces around delimiters. Kind vocabulary: yes,confirm,no,refuse,other,answer,third_party,wrong_number,deceased,human,restructuring,stop,about_call,paid,dispute,hardship,too_much,proposal,partial,correction,vague,ai_question,scam_question,unknown_question. Same vocabulary in every phase and every row. Security answer is DOB YYYY-MM-DD (numeric dates DMY) or four phone digits. Payment date is ISO or today/tomorrow/next weekday/this weekday; next weekday means following calendar week. Never extract negated or incidental dates. Amount is decimal digits with at most two cents; no symbols. Aggregate total uses total scope; never distribute it. A partial answer/correction has complete=0 and actual target plus known components; no invented completion. Positive amount/date is proposal, never consent. Yes/confirm only clear agreement to actually spoken terms; changed terms are correction. Agreement in product/counteroffers phase leads to readback, never a write. Separate confirmation in confirm phase must cover every read-back product. For heterogeneous replies use separate rows with each target's own amount/date/completion; never duplicate full speech per product. Current arrears already paid is paid even when refusing an extra payment; historical closure/payoff/never owned is dispute. Negated historic claims are not dispute. Preserve human/restructuring/stop intents despite incidental paid words. Hardship without voluntary proposal precedes restructuring and persuasion. Independent robot/scam questions set ai/scam=1 without dropping the main answer. Always provide event_raw separately. Example security: answer||||1|current|1980-03-14||0|0 followed by newline END. Exact minimal yes row: yes||||1|current|||0|0 followed by newline END. Example mixed reply: proposal|credit card|150.25|tomorrow|1|current|||0|0 newline refuse|personal loan|||1|current|||0|0 newline paid|car loan|||1|current|||0|0 newline END. Phase {{phase}}. Now {{now}}. Accounts {{account_facts}}. Pending {{fragment_facts}}. {{extractor.speech}} {{extractor.conversation.last-10}}

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Extract ONLY the latest reply as plain delimiter text, NEVER JSON. One row per distinct product decision. Every row has exactly ten fields separated by | in this order: kind|products|amount|date|complete|scope|security_answer|callback_time|ai|scam. End with a separate literal END line. Empty facts use empty fields. complete, ai, scam are exactly 0 or 1. scope is current/all/total/each. Products are comma-separated exact returned IDs, known API enums, spaced names (credit card, personal loan, car loan), or exact rendered labels. Escape literal percent as %25, vertical bar as %7C, newline as %0A and comma within a product as %2C. Do not add quotes, brackets, markdown or spaces around delimiters. Kind vocabulary: yes,confirm,no,refuse,other,answer,third_party,wrong_number,deceased,human,restructuring,stop,about_call,paid,dispute,hardship,too_much,proposal,partial,correction,vague,ai_question,scam_question,unknown_question. Same vocabulary in every phase and every row. Security answer is DOB YYYY-MM-DD (numeric dates DMY) or four phone digits. Payment date is ISO or today/tomorrow/next weekday/this weekday; next weekday means following calendar week. Never extract negated or incidental dates. Amount is decimal digits with at most two cents; no symbols. Aggregate total uses total scope; never distribute it. A partial answer/correction has complete=0 and actual target plus known components; no invented completion. Positive amount/date is proposal, never consent. Yes/confirm only clear agreement to actually spoken terms; changed terms are correction. Agreement in product/counteroffers phase leads to readback, never a write. Separate confirmation in confirm phase must cover every read-back product. For heterogeneous replies use separate rows with each target's own amount/date/completion; never duplicate full speech per product. Current arrears already paid is paid even when refusing an extra payment; historical closure/payoff/never owned is dispute. Negated historic claims are not dispute. Preserve human/restructuring/stop intents despite incidental paid words. Hardship without voluntary proposal precedes restructuring and persuasion. Independent robot/scam questions set ai/scam=1 without dropping the main answer. Always provide event_raw separately. Example security: answer||||1|current|1980-03-14||0|0 followed by newline END. Exact minimal yes row: yes||||1|current|||0|0 followed by newline END. Example mixed reply: proposal|credit card|150.25|tomorrow|1|current|||0|0 newline refuse|personal loan|||1|current|||0|0 newline paid|car loan|||1|current|||0|0 newline END. Phase {{phase}}. findings.title: Malformed JSON inside a date field can be salvaged into matching consent
findings.behavior: The malformed today JSON field did NOT match today and did not schedule a write (55); an unknown malformed date also did not write (56). After genuine correction/readback to next Wednesday 2026-12-16 (63), the unterminated JSON date containing next wednesday matched that weekday: scalar (64) and compound (66) confirmation both set confirmed and scheduled the original card 126.84/2026-12-16 request. Plain weekday control (65) also schedules that exact request; explicit incomplete compound flag (67) blocks it. No API executed.
findings.limits: Raw field injection violates NEVER JSON, allowed payment-date token and no quote/bracket extraction instructions. This is a local consumer robustness defect, not an effective conforming witness or model/ASR/hosted reachability claim. Existing readback terms were scheduled, not invented changed terms.
findings.improvement: Validate date token grammar before interpreting weekday text; reject quotes/brackets and unrelated text in typed fields.

findings.title: Complete confirm event trusts completion flag despite unfinished changed-terms speech
findings.behavior: The same unfinished raw speech blocks writes with complete=0 but schedules the first existing read-back promise when typed confirm says complete=1. No changed/new terms are invented; existing terms are scheduled without a grammar-consistent clear consent.
findings.limits: An explicit extractor intent/completion error, not a failure of grammar-conforming partial events. Extraction prompt expressly forbids this mislabeled contract; model/ASR reachability untested.
findings.improvement: If independent consumer defense is required, inconsistent unfinished correction speech should clarify before consent.

findings.title: Terminal END validation normalizes outside whitespace
findings.behavior: END followed by space/tab/newline is stripped and accepted as complete consent. Missing/internal END and trailing nonwhitespace were rejected.
findings.limits: Normalization tolerance only; no incomplete consent salvaged by this alone.
